# Logistics 0.1.2 alpha 11

- Expand Books and Comics reading parity, library navigation, speech, typography, automatic spreads and fold-aware layouts.
- Add a native press-and-hold comic magnifier that samples the image beneath its center and improve mobile navigation clearance.
- Consolidate rclone workflows with transfer review, retry handling, remote browsing and direct readers.
- Keep multiple saved and session-only credential packages side by side, with separate privacy gates and remote identities.
- Improve storage navigation, privacy controls, fullscreen behavior and tablet viewport sizing.
- Make native test startup idempotent across Android activity recreation and keep real downloads active long enough to verify concurrent browsing on hosted emulators.
- Validate source-page decoding independently of tablet spreads and isolate mocked native tests from optional mobile packages.

The iOS TestFlight application version is 0.1.6. Publication requires all desktop platform, native mobile and mobile runtime checks to pass. This candidate includes the latest committed commonUtils and Logistics changes and supersedes the earlier unpublished candidates.
